rules.description: Eligible experience and project bullets should communicate an accomplishment, measurable evidence, and the method used.
rules.guidance: Apply the XYZ method semantically: accomplished X, as measured by Y, by doing Z. Do not require that literal wording or order.

rules.description: Eligible achievement bullets should contain meaningful measurable evidence.
rules.guidance: Count percentages, money, time saved, team size, user volume, performance, reliability, or scale. Do not count dates, phone numbers, software versions, or section numbering.

rules.description: Candidates below five years of relevant experience should use at most one nonblank content page; candidates with five or more years may use two.
rules.guidance: Count only nonblank pages and do not double-count overlapping professional roles.

rules.description: Meaningful achievement metrics should receive selective visual emphasis.
rules.guidance: Evaluate meaningful achievement metrics, not dates, phone numbers, software versions, or every number indiscriminately.
